app.notes: Sailor Companion 1.0. New look, a resizable window, keyboard focus rings, a first-run welcome, signed updates, crash logging and a support file. Pirate Odyssey now has a schedule. Events 3.3.0: the rewards preview lists every reward. Sleep 2.3.0: skips frozen clients, and its shutdown timer survives a Companion restart.

modules.name: Sailor Events
modules.author: Evolex
modules.description: Event timers, spoken reminders and an in-game overlay for Arabian Dawn and Pirate Odyssey.
permissions: Countdowns for every event on both servers
Spoken reminders before the events you follow
In-game overlay with your next events

modules.name: SRO Hider
modules.author: Evolex
modules.description: Hide and show Silkroad clients without closing them, from Companion, the tray or Ctrl+Alt+H.
permissions: Hide and show your game clients

modules.name: SRO Sleep
modules.author: Evolex
modules.description: Wakes you with an alarm when the game disconnects, your character dies or the client crashes.
permissions: Alarm when you disconnect, die or the client crashes
Keeps watching while the game is minimized
Optional PC shutdown after a crash

modules.name: Sailor Fixer
modules.author: Evolex & Luminescence
modules.description: Fixes common Silkroad client problems in a few clicks.
permissions: Starts Sailor Fixer with administrator rights (Windows asks first)
